hot_facts: Founded by Vikram Khanna in 2018, originally from Delhi NCR background
Team of 32 people across Mumbai and Chandigarh Tricity offices
Mumbai office: Andheri West, near Infinity Mall
Chandigarh office: Sector 34, near Piccadilly Chowk
RERA registered in Maharashtra (MahaRERA) and Punjab (Punjab RERA)
Primary focus: Thane West, Zirakpur VIP Road, Chandigarh Tricity
250+ families helped across North India, 4.7 Google rating from 60+ reviews
Home loan partnerships with SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Bank of Baroda
Strong NRI clientele from Dubai, Canada, UK — especially Punjab-origin clients
Weekend site visit fleet: 3 vehicles Mumbai, 2 vehicles Chandigarh

faq.answer: Vikram Khanna sir ne 2018 mein shuru ki thi. Unka 15+ saal ka experience hai real estate mein. Pehle DLF aur Hiranandani mein senior positions pe the, phir apni agency khol li. Delhi NCR se belong karte hain, lekin ab Mumbai base hai unka.
8 saal ho gaye hain — 2018 se. Shuru mein sirf Delhi NCR mein the, 2021 mein Mumbai expand kiya, aur 2023 mein Chandigarh Tricity mein ghus gaye. Ab North India ke 3 major markets cover karte hain.

Total 32 log hain. Mumbai office mein 18 hain — 8 sales consultants, 3 CRM, 2 site coordinators, 2 loan advisors, 3 admin. Chandigarh office mein 14 hain. Main personally Mumbai-Thane handle karta hoon.

Hamara mission hai — transparent deals, no false promises. Punjabi mein kehte hain: 'Sach bolna, clear price dikhana.' Har project RERA verified, har price builder se confirm. Koi hidden charge nahi, koi jumla nahi.

Bilkul sir. Mumbai ke liye MahaRERA registered hain — agent ID A5170000XXXX. Chandigarh ke liye Punjab RERA registered. Aur jitne projects bechte hain, sabke alag alag RERA numbers hain. Aap official website pe verify kar sakte hain — maharera.mahaonline.gov.in ya punjabrera.org.
CREDAI West ne 2024 mein 'Emerging Brokerage of the Year' diya tha. Google pe 4.7 star rating hai 60+ reviews se. NRI clients se bahut achha response milta hai — especially Dubai-Punjab corridor se.
Andheri West mein hai — Infinity Mall ke paas, Link Road pe. Landmark: Oshiwara Police Station ke bilkul saamne, 3rd floor. Parking basement mein available hai.

Chandigarh office Sector 34 mein hai — Piccadilly Chowk ke paas. Zirakpur clients ke liye site pe hi mil lete hain kyunki VIP Road pe hi projects hain. Mohali mein bhi site visits arrange ho jati hain.
Monday to Saturday, subah 9:30 se shaam 7 baje tak. Sunday off rehta hai lekin site visits appointment pe ho jati hain. NRI clients ke liye evening slots bhi available hain.

questions: Mil sakte hain face to face?
Office mein baat kar sakte hain?
faq.answer: Zaroor sir, aa jaiye! Andheri office mein baith ke poora discussion kar lenge. Brochures, floor plans, sample flat videos sab ready rehta hai. Chai-coffee ke saath relaxed mein baat karenge. Appointment leke aaiye taaki wait na karna pade.

Main Senior Property Consultant hoon VK Realty mein. Kaam hai clients ko right property dikhana — budget samajhna, family needs dekhna, aur best 2-3 options suggest karna. Mumbai-Thane aur Chandigarh Tricity dono handle karta hoon.
Mere manager hain Vikram Khanna sir — Branch Head Mumbai. Unse report karta hoon. 15+ saal ka experience hai unko. Pehle Hiranandani aur Lodha mein the.

questions: Kab se VK Realty mein ho?
faq.answer: VK Realty mein 4 saal ho gaye. Usse pehle 2 saal Sobha Limited mein tha Bengaluru mein, phir Mumbai shift ho gaya. Total 6 saal real estate mein. Thane aur Zirakpur market ko achhe se jaanta hoon.
Sobha Limited mein tha 2 saal — Bengaluru mein. Wahan se construction quality, luxury segment, aur NRI client handling seekha. Phir Mumbai aa gaya kyunki yahan market zyada dynamic hai.

B.Tech kiya hai NIT Warangal se. Lekin real estate mein interest tha toh yahi line mein aa gaya. Tech background ka fayda yeh hai ki IT/tech clients ko achhe se samajh pata hoon — jo hamara major client base hai.

Personally 50-60 deals close kiye hain Mumbai-Thane mein. Chandigarh Tricity mein alag se 30+ deals. Total 250+ families ko help kiya hai. Referrals se 40% clients aate hain — matlab purane clients khud bhejte hain.

questions: Site dekhne ka process kya hai?
Site visit arrange kar sakte ho?
faq.answer: Bahut easy hai sir. Date aur time bataiye, hamari team arrange kar degi. Mumbai mein 3 vehicles hain, Chandigarh mein 2. Saturday-Sunday site visit days hain. Builder ke sample flat aur actual construction site dono dikhayenge.

questions: Booking ke liye kya laana hai?
faq.answer: Booking ke liye: PAN card, Aadhaar card, 2 photos, cheque book. Home loan ke liye: 3 months salary slip, 6 months bank statement, Form 16. NRI ke liye: passport, visa, NRE/NRO details, Power of Attorney if needed.

questions: Booking ke liye kitna dena hai?
faq.answer: Usually ₹1-2 lakh token dete hain initially. Phir agreement ke time 10% of total value. Baaki construction-linked plan mein jaata hai. Thane mein ₹50,000 se bhi booking start ho jati hai kuch projects mein.
Typical CLP: 10% booking, 10% agreement, 15% plinth, 10% per slab, 20% possession, 5% registration. Maharashtra mein RERA ke rules strict hain — builder ko timeline follow karni hoti hai.

Haan ji, full help karenge. SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Bank of Baroda — sabke saath tie-up hai. Current rate 8.4-8.5% chal raha hai. Pre-approval letter dete hain taaki aapko negotiation mein fayda ho. Processing fee 0.25-1%.

questions: Dubai se hoon, kaise buy karun?
faq.answer: Bilkul sir, NRI hamara major client base hai especially Punjab-origin from Dubai, Canada, UK. Video call pe sab discuss kar lenge. Power of Attorney bana sakte hain India mein kisi relative ko. NRE/NRO se payment hota hai. FEMA compliant poora process.

questions: Stamp duty kitna hai Maharashtra mein?
faq.answer: Maharashtra mein stamp duty 5% + 1% registration + metro cess = approximately 6-7% total. Punjab mein 6% stamp duty + 1% registration = 7% total. Hamara legal team full guidance deta hai. Sub-registrar pe hamara banda rehta hai.

Cancellation builder ke terms pe depend karta hai. Usually token non-refundable hota hai lekin main builder se negotiate karke kuch waapas nikalwa sakta hoon. Agreement ke pehle zyada flexibility hoti hai.

Direct-builder partnerships pe zero brokerage hota hai. Baaki mein standard 1-2% of property value. Lekin focus yeh hai ki client ko best deal mile — hidden charges kabhi nahi rakhte. Builder se discount nikalwa ke dete hain.

questions: Koi aur sasta de raha hai?
faq.answer: Builder ke list price se neeche main 2-5% discount nikalwa sakta hoon — corporate discount, early bird, ya festive offer ke through. Hamara builder relation strong hai. Price transparency guarantee hai — jo builder bolega wahi batayenge.

questions: Kaun se areas cover karte ho?
faq.answer: Mumbai mein: Thane West, Ghodbunder Road, Kolshet Road, Majiwada. Chandigarh Tricity mein: Zirakpur VIP Road, Mohali Aerocity, New Chandigarh. Basically growth corridors jo metro aur infrastructure se connect ho rahe hain.

questions: Mumbai mein lena chahiye ya Chandigarh?
faq.answer: Budget aur purpose pe depend karta hai. ₹1-2 crore budget hai toh Thane best hai — Metro Line 4 aa raha hai, bullet train station bhi hai. ₹50 lakh-1 crore hai toh Zirakpur best — Chandigarh se connected, metro approved, aur appreciation 15-20% annually.
Haan ji, aaj Andheri office mein hoon. Kal subah 11 baje tak free hoon. Aa jaiye, chai peene ke baad poora property tour karayenge. Site visit bhi same day arrange kar denge.

Thane mein bahut achha time hai sir. Metro Line 4 December 2025 se operational hai, bullet train 2028 tak aa raha hai. Last 2 saal mein Thane mein 15-20% appreciation hua hai. Infrastructure push ki wajah se aur growth hai.

Zirakpur mein excellent time hai. VIP Road pe rates ₹5,000-6,800 per sq ft hain. Metro approve ho gayi hai Chandigarh ki, completion 2025-26 expected hai. NRI demand bahut hai Punjab-origin buyers se. 8-12% annual appreciation expected hai.

questions: NRI ke liye best area kaun sa hai?
Dubai se hoon, kahan lena chahiye?
NRIs ke liye kahan best hai?
faq.answer: NRI ke liye Zirakpur best hai — VIP Road pe projects hain, Chandigarh se 10 minute, airport 15 minute. Punjab-origin NRIs ko apna culture aur community milti hai. Thane bhi achha hai lekin budget zyada chahiye — ₹1.5 crore se upar.

questions: Sunday site visit kar sakte hain?
faq.answer: Saturday-Sunday dono din site visit hoti hai. Main personally Saturday available rehta hoon. Sunday appointment pe aa sakta hoon. Weekdays shaam 5-7 baje bhi site visit possible hai.

questions: Aapka favorite project kaun sa hai?
faq.answer: Thane ke liye Lodha Amara bahut pasand hai — 40 acres, 70% open space, 6 swimming pools, budget ₹85 lakh se start. Zirakpur ke liye Sushma Belleza — luxury 3-4 BHK, VIP Road pe, ₹1.35 crore se. Dono value for money hain.
